conclusions: REJECTED_AFTER_BASE is intentionally blind to every early admission gate.
BROAD_CONTROL is not a universal early-gate control because it preconditions on >=60 history, >=10 price and primary minLots liquidity.
The only complete systematic early-gate Shadow hole among strategy gates found here is the primary below-minLots rejection; other strategy gates have at best incidental bounded coverage.
Market-cap<10bn is the remaining standalone strategy-universe gate not yet given a dedicated falsification design.
Data-quality gates must not be treated as alpha/optimization thresholds.
next: Freeze a market-cap<10bn redundancy/cost falsification spec before considering any size-floor change.
Do not build separate cohorts for missing-data gates as if they were trade opportunities; build completeness QA instead.

Prefer one future isolated early-admission audit receipt carrying exact first rejection reason and total counts, then dedicated sampling for high-value strategy gates, rather than proliferating ad-hoc cohorts.
